neighbours.label: the split-off subword token 'ard' inside a name or word (Woodard, Chardonnay, Millard, Gerard, Bombardier, Tardis, lard), meaning-blind; whole-word tokens ending in -ard fire partly (' ward' ~0.7, ' bard' 0.6, ' guard' 0.45) or weakly (' hard', ' standard', ' toward' < 0.2), and pieces like 'ardy' less
fire: Alfre Woodard gave a moving speech.
The Chardonnay was crisp and cold.
Millard Fillmore was the thirteenth president.
The Tardis vanished with a wheeze.
She fried the eggs in lard.
quiet: Alfre Woodford gave a moving speech.
The Chablis was crisp and cold.
Franklin Pierce was the fourteenth president.
The spaceship vanished with a wheeze.
She fried the eggs in butter.
